decisions.reason: It is a close extension of the firm's existing carrier-wafer knowledge and fits its direction into reusable carriers, so the firm can readily interpret results and improve the product.
As a flagship building on established glass-wafer and coating/structuring capabilities, the firm has sufficient related knowledge to assimilate early feedback and refine the copper interposer.
This off-the-shelf brand is essentially a repackaging of the firm's core glass and quartz wafer competencies, requiring little new knowledge and aligning with its existing offer.

Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the firm's semiconductor-wafer knowledge and require unfamiliar circuit-board manufacturing and customer expertise, making it difficult to assimilate feedback and improve the product.
